cards.audioText: Your call sign is CSN817, you are from Wuhan to Guangzhou, gate 213, information G received, request ATC clearance.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是南方817，从武汉飞往广州，213号停机位，收到通播G，请求放行许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CSN817, gate 213, information G received, request ATC clearance to Guangzhou.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，南方817，213号停机位，收到通播G，请求到广州的放行许可。

cards.audioText: CSN817, cleared to destination Guangzhou via flight planned route, runway 36R, follow LKO-01 departure, initially climb to 1200m, cruising level 8400m, when airborne contact departure 119.7, squawk 3115.
cards.audioTextZh: 南方817，可以经由计划航路飞往广州，跑道36右，按照LKO-01离场，初始爬升至1200米，巡航高度8400米，离地后联系离场119.7，应答机3115。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to destination Guangzhou via flight planned route, runway 36R, LKO-01 departure, initially climb to 1200m, cruising level 8400m, when airborne contact departure 119.7, squawk 3115, CSN817.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以经由计划航路飞往广州，跑道36右，LKO-01离场，初始爬升至1200米，巡航高度8400米，离地后联系离场119.7，应答机3115，南方817。

cards.audioText: Now you are pushed back with the engines running, request taxi instructions.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在飞机推出，发动机启动，请求滑行指令。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CSN817, request taxi instructions.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，南方817，请求滑行指令。

cards.audioText: CSN817, taxi via Z4, A3, A to holding point of runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: 南方817，经由Z4，A3，A滑行至跑道36右外等待点。
cards.referenceText: Taxi via Z4, A3, A to holding point of runway 36R, CSN817.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经由Z4，A3，A滑行至跑道36右外等待点，南方817。

cards.audioText: CSN 817, taxi with caution, men and equipment are operating at the east of taxiway A.
cards.audioTextZh: 南方817，谨慎滑行，滑行道A东侧和人员和设备施工。

cards.audioText: You encountered the wind shear between 200m to 400m, report the situation to ATC.
cards.audioTextZh: 你在200米到400米之间遇到风切变，将情况报告给管制员。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, CSN817, we encountered wind shear between 200m to 400m.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，南方817，我们在200米到400米之间遇到风切变。

cards.audioText: Now you are cruising at 7800m, approaching DAPRO, make an initial contact with Guangzhou Control.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你在78000米巡航，接近DAPRO，和广州区调进行初始联系。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Control, CSN817, 7800m maintaining, approaching DAPRO.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州区调，南方817，在7800米巡航，接近DAPRO.

cards.audioText: CSN817, Guangzhou Control, radar identified, omit position report.
cards.audioTextZh: 南方817，广州区调，雷达识别了，省略位置报。

cards.audioText: As you were descending to 4200m, you executed TCAS RA climbing maneuver, report the situation to controller.
cards.audioTextZh: 当你下降到4200米时，你执行了TCAS RA爬升机动，将情况告知管制员。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Control, CSN817, we executed TCAS RA climbing maneuver when we were descending to 4200m.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州区调，南方817，我们在下降到4200米时，执行了TCAS RA爬升机动。

cards.audioText: Now the conflicted traffic is clear, resume descend. Report the situation to the controller.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在和航空器取消冲突，继续下降，将情况报告给管制员。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Control, CSN817, now the conflicted traffic is clear, resuming descend.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州区调，南方817，现在和航空器解除冲突，继续下降。

cards.audioText: Now you are established on the ILS approach runway 36R, tell the controller you cannot see PAPI light.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你建立了跑道36右的盲降，告诉管制员，你看不到PAPI灯。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Tower, CSN817, established on the ILS approach runway 36R, but we cannot see PAPI light.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州塔台，南方817，建立了跑道36右的盲降，但是我们看不到PAPI灯。

cards.audioText: CSN817, cleared to land, PAPI light is out of service.
Ask for a follow me car after landing.
cards.audioTextZh: 着陆后请求一辆引导车。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Tower, CSN817, request a follow me car after landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州塔台，南方817，着陆后请求一辆引导车。

cards.audioText: Roger, CSN817, the follow me car will be waiting for you on the taxiway A.
cards.audioTextZh: 收到，南方817，引导车将在滑行道A处等你。
